name: Chill Guy
aka: My New Character Is A Chill Guy
look: A drawing of a brown cartoon dog with a big dark nose and a smug smirk, wearing a gray sweater and light blue jeans with his hands in his pockets, pasted onto a photo of a grassy field under an orange sunset sky.
use: Captions set up a stressful or awkward situation, and the dog stays totally unbothered, usually summed up as being 'just a chill guy'. Used for someone who doesn't care, or pretends not to.
examples: Group project due tomorrow and nobody has started
Phone at 2% with no charger in sight
describe: cartoon dog in a sweater with hands in pockets smirking
brown dog guy in jeans standing relaxed in a field
smug cartoon dog in a gray sweater not caring
dog character with a big nose standing calm at sunset
laid back cartoon guy in a grassy field with hands in pockets
origin: A character drawn by artist Phillip Banks that became a viral meme in late 2024.
